notes.title: The Spooktacular Autumn Update
notes.notes:
[p]🎃 [b]The Spooktacular Autumn Update — Coming Soon to Your Restaurant![/b] 🍁[/p][p align="start"]Fog slowly creeps through the streets, windows start to gather cobwebs, and the air carries the scent of pumpkin pie and a hint of magic…
[b]Halloween is on its way[/b], bringing a fresh wave of cozy chills, spooky charm, and delicious surprises!
But don’t light the candles just yet — [b]the best is just a couple of weeks away[/b].[/p][p align="start"]🧙‍♀️ [b]Our heroes are already in costume and getting ready![/b]
They’ve pulled out their most mysterious outfits from storage and are preparing for the most magical night of the year:[/p][list][*][p]🧙‍♀️ The [b]adorable little witch[/b] will become the [b]magical head chef[/b] — cooking over a cauldron, chanting spells over soups, and personally delivering dishes with a puff of smoke and a spark of magic.[/p][/*][*][p]🧛 The [b]stylish vampire[/b] will take his place at the register — accepting payments with flawless politeness, handling orders, and listening to even the strangest requests (yes, ghosts still want salt-free meals).[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]They’re already in the kitchen… but staying in the shadows for now. [b]Their grand debut is just around the corner![/b][/p][p align="start"]🎃 [b]Exclusive Collections — Only for Halloween![/b]
We’ve prepared [b]three unique sets[/b], available [b]only during the holiday season[/b].[/p][p align="start"]❗ These items will be available for a [b]limited time only[/b] and will vanish after Halloween ends. Don’t miss your chance to create a truly atmospheric restaurant![/p][p align="start"]🔧 [b]Improved Difficulty — Smoother & More Enjoyable[/b]
Based on your feedback, we’ve fine-tuned several levels[/p][p align="start"]✨ [b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"]🍁 [b]Stay tuned — the celebration begins in just a couple of weeks![/b]
In the meantime, prepare your kitchen, dust off the broom, and get into the spooky spirit.
[/p][p align="start"]With a wisp of magic and the whisper of pumpkins,
[b]The Development Team[/b] 🎃✨[/p]
